messages:
sam: Quick sync — HW slotting proposal for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi. Thinking staggered marketplace announcements to avoid overlapping press embargoes and to give SI teams time to onboard. Draft schedule below, needs lab & release engineering input. Pinged @anders @monica @kian. Link: https://go/redwood/slotting-draft :calendar:

priya: Can you paste dates? Also what are the gating criteria for SI certification? Do we need extended driver testing for MI300?

sam: Draft dates (UTC):
```
H100 - NA marketplace: 2026-06-10 (partner preview 06-03)
MI300 - Early partner beta: 2026-06-24 (compat images 06-17)
B200/H200 - GA tentative: 2026-07-08
Gaudi - staggered EU/APAC: 2026-07-22 -> 2026-07-29
```
Gating: lab pass, SI integration signoff, marketplace image published + smoke tests. We can shift by a week if lab capacity is blocked.

anders: Lab note — we have a planned firmware test window 2026-06-11..13 for NA rack refresh. That collides with H100 NA GA if we keep 06-10. Recommend move H100 GA to 06-17 or keep GA but schedule NA rack exclusion for canary nodes.

monica: Kernel vendor pushed a 5.20.8 driver fix that'll land 06-15. If we want MI300 compat images by 06-17 it's tight. Options: (1) target MI300 partner beta 06-24 but freeze images 06-18 and ship with driver hotfix, (2) delay MI300 to 06-30. Recommend option 1 + canary.

kian: From partnerships side — vendors have press embargos week of 06-08 and 06-22. We need to stagger announcement windows by region and avoid NA+EU same-week. Also request reserved press slot with vendor comms on 06-03 for H100 partner preview.

priya: For SI rollout — can we define 'integration signoff' checklist? Suggest: infra provisioning, driver image tests (smoke + perf), cached model load test, end-to-end inference tests under 95th percentile latency. We should also add fallback model variant policy for initial 72h.

sam: Agreed. I'll draft a condensed checklist and add rollback/fallback policy. Proposed runbook snippet:
```
- Day -7: publish marketplace image candidate
- Day -3: SI onramp smoke tests
- Day 0: announce partner preview
- Day +1..+3: monitor traces, token-cost delta, perf regressions
- If >X failures => rollback to previous image
```

deploy-bot: [CI] marketplace-image:mi300-rc.3 build passed (06-15T14:12Z) :white_check_mark:

monica: Good — deploy-bot result helps. If we freeze on 06-18, we have one full week for canary/perf runs.

anders: I'll reserve two racks for canaries 06-17..06-23 and coordinate SI slots.

kian: I'll lock press slot with vendor PR team for 06-03 NA preview. Please confirm ASAP.

sam: OK — action items:
- @anders reserve canaries & confirm lab window
- @monica confirm driver shipping plan and image freeze date
- @priya finalize SI signoff checklist + fallback policy
- @kian reserve press slots and vendor comms
I'll update the draft schedule doc. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll propose final dates to vendors. :thumbsup:
